  major [Data Integrity & Integration]
  → migrations/0007_backfill_plan.sql:8

  Do not overwrite existing account plans.

  UPDATE accounts SET plan = 'free' affects every row. If an account
  already has a non-NULL plan, this statement replaces it with 'free'.
  Update only rows that require the backfill.


  Proposed fix

  -UPDATE accounts SET plan = 'free';
  +UPDATE accounts SET plan = 'free' WHERE plan IS NULL;
